articles.title: Philadelphia museum closes despite campaign and temporary funding offer
articles.summary: The Academy of Natural Sciences Museum has closed after financial difficulties. Supporters, a foundation and Philadelphia's city council are pursuing possible ways to restore public access.

articles.title: Court pauses Big Bend border projects while legal challenge continues
articles.summary: A federal court temporarily halted border infrastructure work across Texas' Big Bend region. A lawsuit challenges the government's decision to bypass environmental, cultural and archaeological protections.

articles.title: September hiring slows, while Fed official stresses inflation concerns
articles.summary: US employers added 29,000 jobs in September, below expectations. Cleveland Fed president Beth Hammack cautioned against judging one report alone and highlighted pressure from prices rising faster than wages.
